concept: Review and integration: what does it mean to 'keep your word' across the stories so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of the three stories we've explored, which one felt most like something that could really happen to you?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'honor' means to them so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition, however simple, connecting to at least one prior story
